print("human ADCK5 Q3MIX3 length",len(H))
seqs={}
for q in ["(gene:ADCK5) AND (taxonomy_id:33208) AND (length:[400 TO 900])",
          "(protein_name:\"aarF domain containing kinase 5\") AND (taxonomy_id:33208) AND (length:[400 TO 900])"]:
    t=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":q,"format":"fasta","size":500},timeout=180).text
    for e in [x for x in t.split("\n>") if x.strip()]:
        e=e.lstrip(">"); h=e.split("\n")[0]; s="".join(e.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
        m=re.search(r"OS=(.+?) OX=",h); sp=m.group(1) if m else "?"
        acc=h.split("|")[1] if "|" in h else h.split()[0]
        if acc=="Q3MIX3": continue
        if sp not in seqs or len(s)>len(seqs[sp][1]): seqs[sp]=(acc,s)

M62=np.array([[int(x) for x in r_.split()] for r_ in blos.strip().split("\n")]); ai={c:i for i,c in enumerate(B62)}
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); s1i=np.array([ai.get(c,22) for c in s1]); s2i=np.array([ai.get(c,22) for c in s2])
    NEG=-1e9; M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0; X[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); Y[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m)
    jj=np.arange(m+1); ar=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sc=M62[s1i[i-1],s2i]
        prev=np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],X[i-1,:-1],Y[i-1,:-1]])
        M[i,1:]=prev.max(0)+sc; pM[i,1:]=prev.argmax(0)
        a=np.maximum(M[i-1],Y[i-1])+go; b=X[i-1]+ge
        X[i]=np.maximum(a,b); pX[i]=np.where(a>=b,np.where(M[i-1]>=Y[i-1],0,2),1)
        v=np.maximum(M[i],X[i])+go-ge*jj
        cm=np.maximum.accumulate(v[:m]); Y[i,1:]=ge*ar[1:]+cm
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); al={}
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: al[i]=j; ns=pM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1; st=int(ns)
        elif st==1: ns=pX[i,j]; i-=1; st=int(ns)
        else:
            k=int(np.argmax(np.maximum(M[i,:j],X[i,:j])+go-ge*np.arange(j))) if j>0 else 0
            st=0 if M[i,k]>=X[i,k] else 1; j=k
        if i<0 or j<0: break
    return al

for sp,(acc,s) in sorted(seqs.items()):
    a=nw(H,s); ident=sum(1 for i,j in a.items() if H[i-1]==s[j-1]); pid=100*ident/len(a)
    if pid<35 or len(a)<300: excl.append((sp,acc,pid,len(a))); continue
    n_ok+=1; kept.append((sp,acc,pid))
    for i,j in a.items():
